title: Historical Sale Item Snapshot Availability
scope: Historical Sales Recorded Prior to Phase 9
current_behavior: All new sales capture immutable snapshot fields (`product_name`, `sku`, `unit_cost`, `barcode`) directly in `sale_items`.
legacy_limitation: Historical sales created prior to migration MIG-001 have NULL snapshots. The system reads historical details via backward-compatible product joins. The Artisan command `php artisan hbos:backfill-sale-item-snapshots` defaults to DRY-RUN mode and logs non-authoritative approximation provenance in command output without mutating historical truth.
operational_guidance: Invoices reprinted for legacy transactions reflect catalog state at migration time; new transactions are permanently frozen.

title: Historical Khata Ledger & Customer Balance Reconciliation
scope: Historical Customer Ledger Records Prior to Phase 9
current_behavior: All new credit sales, payments, and refunds maintain strictly atomic double-entry balance updates on `customers.balance`.
legacy_limitation: Pre-remediation discrepancies in customer balances are not blindly auto-corrected. The read-only command `php artisan hbos:audit-khata-ledger-discrepancies` audits ledger variance and requires manual administrative verification before posting compensating adjustments.
operational_guidance: Accountants must review khata discrepancy audit reports and obtain customer confirmation before posting adjustments.

title: Legacy Expense Records with NULL Financial Account
scope: Historical Expense Records Prior to Phase 9
current_behavior: New expenses strictly require a valid, active `financial_account_id` validated server-side.
legacy_limitation: Legacy expense rows with NULL `financial_account_id` cannot have historical funding sources deterministically inferred. The command `php artisan hbos:repair-null-expense-accounts` (defaults to dry-run) allocates unassigned expenses to an explicit holding account `UNALLOCATED_HISTORICAL_EXPENSES` rather than guessing arbitrary bank accounts.
operational_guidance: Do not guess funding accounts for legacy audit records; maintain them with appropriate audit holding accounts.

title: Historical Orphan Financial Movement Reconciliation
scope: Legacy Financial Movements Prior to Phase 9
current_behavior: All financial movements are generated exclusively via AccountService with explicit parent entity reference and unique compound keys.
legacy_limitation: Historical orphan movements from deleted expenses are reconciled via `php artisan hbos:reconcile-financial-movements` (defaults to dry-run) using compensating void movements rather than destructive row deletion.
operational_guidance: Use compensating journal adjustments rather than raw deletion when balancing historical financial accounts.

title: Historical Expense Category Monthly Budget Records
scope: Historical Expense Categories Prior to Phase 9
current_behavior: Monthly budget targets are persisted on `expense_categories.monthly_budget` and displayed in expense budgeting views.
legacy_limitation: Historical expense categories have NULL `monthly_budget` where no budget was ever configured.
operational_guidance: Management can set current monthly budgets in Expense Category settings; historical periods remain unbudgeted.

title: Frontend Automated Test Suite Configuration
current_behavior: Frontend code compiles cleanly via Vite production build (`npm run build`) with 170 modules transformed and 0 errors.
legacy_limitation: No automated unit/component test runner (Vitest/Jest) is configured in `Frontend/package.json`. Quality assurance relies on full backend API test coverage (380 tests) and Vite build verification.
operational_guidance: Frontend UI regressions are verified via Vite build checks, API integration tests, and manual verification drills.

title: Unrouted Prototype View Retention
current_behavior: All operational printing is executed via modal overlays (`ThermalReceiptModal.vue`, `A4InvoiceModal.vue`) and consolidated `printerService.js`.
legacy_limitation: Files `ProductInvoiceView.vue` and `reports1View.vue` remain in the codebase as UNROUTED_BUT_RETAINED legacy templates. They are unreachable from active navigation and `/reports1` redirects to `/reports`.
operational_guidance: Operators use standard print triggers in Sales History and POS; unrouted templates are ignored.
